summary: scripts/evidence-flip-ready reads a gate job that was cancelled before it wrote a log (GitHub answers 404 for its log) as having no decision line instead of failing the whole cycle as unreadable; any other job whose log cannot be read still makes the cycle unreadable.

replay.detail: A read-only helper script that reports when a check's flip trigger holds; no skip policy, workflow, gate, verifier, protocol, schema or CLI change.

rules.detail: Changes only whether evidence-flip-ready can finish a cycle when a replaced run's cancelled gates left no log; no skip policy or gate rule changes.
